title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E12 — Private School
Mark is assigned to teach Black history at an expensive private school for one week. When the principal offers him a job at a much higher salary, Mark has a big decision to make.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E13 — For Whom the Heck the Bell Tolls
Not wanting to admit that he can't remember a recently deceased basketball coach, Mark agrees to give the eulogy at his funeral.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E14 — It's My Party and I'll Die If I Want to
It is almost Mark's 30th birthday, and Tyler discovers a lump on Mark. After a misunderstanding with his doctor, Mark thinks that he is dying so he goes skydiving and gives away his stuff.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E15 — The Courtship of Mark Cooper
Mark is in the midst of defending himself in court when he realizes the plaintiff's lawyer is an ex-girlfriend he dumped brutally.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E12 — He Doth Protest Too Much
Moesha discovers that some of her college classes are more difficult than she thought; she has a hard time in Chemistry and reluctantly agrees to let Niecy tutor her.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E13 — Let’s Talk About Sex
Moesha crashes in Niecy’s dorm room after a late-night Pendulum party and is horrified to discover that Nicey has also let a male sleep in the room.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E14 — Secrets and Lies
The arrival of Frank’s Aunt Hattie brings a shocking revelation about Frank that turns the rest of the family – especially Dorian and Moesha – against him.

title: Moesha
description:
S5 E15 — Color Him Father
Still reeling from the news that Frank is Dorian’s biological father, the Mitchells prepare for Dorian’s 17th birthday bash, a party that grows more and more elaborate and expensive as Dorian takes full advantage of Frank’s guilt.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S2 E3 — No Rules
Michael decides to let the kids do as they please.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S2 E4 — Perfect Dad
The kids confront Michael with a description of the ideal dad.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S2 E5 — Thru Thick and Thin
Michael remains silent about Janet's obvious weight gain.

title: My Wife and Kids
description:
S2 E6 — He Heard, She Heard
Michael teaches Claire a lesson after she sneaks out.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E22 — The Big Mother Of A Mother's Day Rides Again Episode
When half-sisters Dee Dee and Mona compete over who can give the best Mother’s Day gift, the special day is overshadowed by their materialistic gestures.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E23 — The Big Rules Of Engagement Episode
Despite going to great lengths to impress Nick's parents, Mona learns from Dee Dee that they don't approve of interracial relationships, but when she attempts to confront Nick about it, he stops her short with a marriage proposal.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E24 — The Big My Lover My Brother Episode
Dee Dee's overzealous attempts to help Mona bounce back from her recent broken engagement unintentionally drive Mona into Spencer's passionate arms. Alicia  Calaway guest stars as a trainer.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E1 — The Big My Little Pony Episode
When Mona finds out the pony Charles gave Dee Dee when they were kids is still around (who she named 'Daddy's Favorite'), Mona's childhood feelings of sibling rivalry resurface.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E18 — Hero
Mark becomes a local hero but an awards ceremony reveals the truth. ELIHU HARRIS, the mayor of Oakland, guest stars as himself in his acting debut. DICK CLARK also appears as himself.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E19 — Here Comes the Groom
Mark's good advice to Earvin about romance somehow causes Earvin to elope with his new girlfriend, and Earvin's mother wants Mark to stop the couple.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E20 — The Matchmaker
Geneva's crazy Aunt Eunetta (also played by SAUNDRA QUARTERMAN) comes to visit and decides that roommates Mark and Vanessa would be the perfect couple. Nicole is upset when Tyler and his friend won't let her play in their boys-only clubhouse.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E21 — Guy's Night Out
Mark tries to help Geneva's boyfriend become a part of his group of male friends with disastrous results. Nicole hides a stray cat in her room, but Vanessa is allergic to cats.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S3 E22 — High Hopes
It looks like Mark, Geneva and Vanessa may all be leaving Oakland forever due to some unexpected surprises--good and bad--in this season finale cliffhanger.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E1 — Together Again
Mark, Vanessa and Geneva return to Oakland after their plans go awry. Geneva gets promoted to high school principal and wonders if she should rehire Mark.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E2 — It's A Matter Of Principal
Mark takes advantage of Geneva's position as high school principal. Vanessa refuses to return her wedding gifts, which gives Nicole and Tyler a naughty idea.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S4 E3 — R.O.T.C
Mark becomes the faculty advisor for a student military program and learns that war games are no fun.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E19 — In Sickness And In Health
Nikki masquerades as a doctor, and T’s racy music video causes a campus controversy.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E20 — Kim Who?
An accident causes Kim to lose her memory.

title: The Parkers
description:
S2 E21 — Love And Hisses
Nikki and Kim’s new boyfriends are hiding big secrets.
